tagline: Sprinklr provides a Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) platform powered by proprietary AI, enabling customer-facing teams to collaborate across silos, communicate across digital and traditional channels, and deliver improved customer experiences at scale.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Remaining Performance Obligation (RPO) is a key indicator of Sprinklr's future performance, representing contractual revenues not yet recognized. It reflects visibility and stability of future revenues in the enterprise software sector, with RPO stable at $986.5 million despite macroeconomic challenges.

kpis.name: Remaining Performance Obligation
kpis.explanation: Contractual revenues not yet recognized, including deferred revenues and amounts to be invoiced and recognized in future periods.
kpis.description: RPO represents future revenues guaranteed by customer contracts. A high value indicates strong demand and a solid backlog.
kpis.signal: Stability of future revenues despite a slight decline.

kpis.name: Current Remaining Performance Obligation
kpis.explanation: Contractual revenues not yet recognized to be recognized within the next 12 months.
kpis.description: cRPO represents the portion of RPO that will be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months, providing short-term revenue visibility.

kpis.name: Net Dollar Expansion Rate
kpis.explanation: Measures the ability to retain and grow subscription revenues from existing customers.
kpis.description: Indicates whether revenues from existing customers are increasing (upsells, expansion) faster than they are decreasing (churn, contraction). An NDE above 100% indicates net expansion.
kpis.signal: Modest growth in revenues from existing customers despite macroeconomic churn.

kpis.name: Number of Large Customers
kpis.explanation: Number of customers generating at least $1 million in subscription revenue over the last 12 months.
kpis.description: Tracks high-value customers, indicating the ability to attract and retain the largest enterprises. The decline is linked to a strategic refinement of the customer profile toward premium segments.
kpis.signal: Slight decrease offset by higher revenue per customer.

kpis.name: Total Number of Customers
kpis.explanation: Total number of customers using the Sprinklr platform.
kpis.description: Indicator of the company's overall reach. The decline is primarily due to a strategic refinement of the customer profile with increased focus on top-tier enterprise customers.
kpis.signal: Strategic reduction in total customer count, reflecting a focus on high-value customers.

kpis.name: AI-Native Platform
kpis.explanation: The Sprinklr platform is designed with artificial intelligence at the core of its architecture, leveraging proprietary AI and automation to manage customer experiences.
kpis.description: Sprinklr positions its platform as 'AI-native', with a purpose-built architecture integrating proprietary AI, collaborative workflow automation, and contextual listening to enhance customer interaction management.
kpis.signal: Proprietary AI and automated collaboration are core elements of Sprinklr's value proposition.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 5 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total Revenue of $0.857 Bn for last fiscal year (FY2026).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net Income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 5 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net Income of $0.023 Bn for last fiscal year (FY2026).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating Income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 5 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating Income of $0.04 Bn for last fiscal year (FY2026).

risks.title: Rising Hosting and Data Costs
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned as a key factor affecting subscription gross margin, with a 27% increase in subscription costs in 2026, primarily due to higher data and cloud infrastructure costs. The impact on margins is immediate and quantified. Managing this risk directly affects short-term profitability.

risks.title: Dependence on Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly states that existing customers are reducing purchases or leaving the platform due to difficult macroeconomic conditions. This risk is recurring, intensified compared to the prior year, and directly affects subscription revenue growth and NDE despite apparent stability.

risks.title: Global Workforce Restructuring
risks.score_rationale: A 12% reduction in global workforce in 2026 led to a significant increase in restructuring expenses. This indicates substantial organizational disruption with risks of losing critical talent, operational misalignment, and potential impact on innovation and customer service capacity.

risks.title: Very Low Professional Services Margin
risks.score_rationale: Gross margin for professional services is close to 0% in 2026, compared to negative margin in 2025. Although structurally low, this business is growing at 29% and heavily reliant on outsourcing. Low profitability limits overall profitability despite volume growth.

risks.title: Pressure on R&D and G&A Personnel Costs
risks.score_rationale: Increase in stock-based compensation costs in R&D (+5%) and general and administrative (+14%), primarily due to new stock awards. Combined with headcount reductions, this rise in unit costs could compress margins if not offset by revenue growth.

risks.title: Reliance on Outsourcing for Professional Services
risks.score_rationale: Substantial increase in outsourcing costs for professional services indicates high dependence on external partners for delivery. This exposes CXM to risks related to service quality, delivery timelines, supplier rate increases, and loss of operational control.

ai_positioning.summary: Sprinklr positions AI as central to its Unified-CXM platform. The 10-K explicitly describes the platform as 'AI-native' and 'powered by proprietary AI', with a purpose-built architecture integrating proprietary AI, collaborative workflow automation, and capabilities to analyze massive amounts of structured and unstructured data. AI is presented as a key component of the value proposition to help enterprises create unified and personalized customer experiences.
evidence: Business description: 'Our AI-native platform enables customer-facing teams... and leverage AI to deliver improved customer experiences at scale.'
Architecture description: 'powered by proprietary AI, collaborative workflow, automation, broad-based listening and customer-led governance'
Architecture purpose: 'designed to help enterprises analyze massive amounts of unstructured and structured data'
Strategic positioning: 'AI-native unified platform purpose-built to help enterprises unify Customer Experience Management'
